propositions: The review-bot uvicorn app logs the webhook authentication token in plaintext within the request line (query string) on every /webhook and /rerun request, exposing it to journald and any system that reads the journal.
The exposed token is the GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN credential, which grants both review-bot permission and Gerrit authentication, making the blast radius a full account compromise.
The exposure is fail-open with no error signal, so the token remains logged on every access until the code is fixed, and rotation alone is insufficient without the code change.
The fix moves the token from the query string to the X-Rebar-Token HTTP header (not logged in access lines) and installs a TokenRedactingFilter to redact any legacy query-string tokens as a backstop.
The operator must rotate the currently-logged GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN independently and track rotation completion, as the code fix alone does not un-leak what is already in journald or shared log excerpts.
